title: DeLonge on Coast to Coast with George Knapp
summary: Jason Simosa tells of DeLonge on Coast to Coast with George Knapp, about 2011 at Coast to Coast AM, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But I think DeLonge was already in the orbit of those conversations, because he'd been on Coast to Coast with George Knapp, 2011.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says the musician Tom DeLonge was already close to talk of UFO secrets well before he became publicly involved. As proof, Simosa points out that DeLonge appeared in 2011 on Coast to Coast AM, a late-night American radio show about the paranormal, with the journalist and host George Knapp.
